If sufficient space cannot be established without provider mutation or deleting the immutable checkpoint, persist a typed pre-science terminal and release.
authorized_repair.endpoint: After the exact image, checkpoint, packet, runtime, and server identity pass, run only the sole unconsumed 791-request endpoint exactly once.

marking endpoint consumption before the first endpoint request is submitted

terminal_contract.success: Persist the endpoint terminal, request-level quality/economic artifacts, exact identities, consumption markers, and release the bench.
